name: xtend
description: XTend UI Web Component Framework with XTendRMT scheduler integration.

post1Rules.major: breaking API, contract, loader, component, Fabric or RMT adapter changes
post1Rules.minor: backward-compatible features, new components, new adapters or optional contracts
post1Rules.patch: backward-compatible fixes, docs, tests, policy clarifications and non-breaking hardening

boundaries: RMT renders the Docs app shell before Parsedown content is inserted
RMT schedules shell, search, rich content and diagnostics records only

scripts.scaffold:dry-run: node xtend-builder/scaffold.js component-files --tag x-example --profile display --feature state --json
scripts.scaffold:typing: node xtend-builder/scaffold.js typing --tag x-example --profile display --feature state --json
scripts.scaffold:preview: node xtend-builder/scaffold.js preview --tag x-example --profile display --feature state --json
scripts.scaffold:extensions: node xtend-builder/scaffold.js extensions --tag x-example --profile display --feature state --json
